topics.text: The hotel provides exceptional service, with attentive and friendly staff who are responsive to guests' needs. The presence of dedicated butlers enhances the overall experience, ensuring timely assistance and personalized care throughout the stay.
The rooms are described as spacious and comfortable, with amenities that enhance relaxation. Features like soft bedding and scenic views from the windows contribute to a restful and enjoyable stay.
Overall, guests find the hotel environment to be clean and well-kept, although some reviews suggest that certain areas could benefit from more meticulous cleaning.

suggestion.text: Some customers suggest improving the cleanliness of the rooms and reducing front desk service confusion, while noting the small size of the infinity pool.
